meta.title: FDP-1 engineering problem register
meta.note: Text in braces is filled from data/fdp1_parameters.json and fdp1diag/model.py at build time: {key!conv} or {key:spec}. TBD marks a value with no adequate source. Status: known, calculated, assumed, unresolved, speculative. Classification: fundamental physics, materials, engineering, unproven technology, hypothetical new science.

requirements.title: Fusion target gain and burn fraction
requirements.description: D-3He pellets must ignite and burn at very high gain; the design only exists above a gain threshold (a cliff, not a slope).
current: gain {fusion.target_gain:,.0f} (assumed), burn fraction {fusion.burn_fraction!pct:0}
rhoR {fusion.rhoR:.0f} g/cm2, {fusion.yield_per_pulse_tTNT:.1f} t TNT per pellet
requirements.gap: x{calc.gain_gap_demonstrated:.0f} above the best demonstrated gain (~{research.nif_best_gain:.0f}, D-T); D-3He ignition never demonstrated

requirements.title: Driver efficiency, repetition rate and reliability
requirements.description: Nine heavy-ion beams must fire {fusion.pellet_rate:.0f} times a second for years, with final optics about {fusion.xray_standoff:.0f} m from each pellet.
current: {fusion.pellet_rate:.0f} Hz, wall-plug {calc.driver_efficiency!pct:0}, {driver.mass!t:3}
{calc.pulses_mission:.2e} pulses over {mission.engine_years:.2f} y of thrust
requirements.gap: TBD: no heavy-ion driver has run at ignition energy or at this cadence; reliability figure TBD

requirements.title: Propulsion power-to-mass ratio
requirements.description: Acceleration is jet power per kilogram. FDP-1 hardware is too heavy per watt for more than ~0.01 g at any ship size.
current: {goal1g.specific_mass:.2e} kg/W jet (1 g check); closure {mass.alpha_jet:.2e}
ceiling {goal1g.max_a0_any_size_g:.4f} g at any size; a0 {prop.a0_g:.4f} g
requirements.gap: x{goal1g.deficit_factor:.0f} lighter per watt; at fixed mass x{calc.1g.factor:.0f} power and power-scaled hardware x{calc.1g.scaled_mass_over_ship:.0f} the whole ship

requirements.title: Magnetic nozzle coupling and structural forces
requirements.description: Three Fiji loops must turn each 19 t TNT pulse into a {prop.plume_half_angle_deg:.0f} deg jet and detach it; loop forces are not designed.
current: jet share {prop.eta_jet!pct} (assumed), loops r {nozzle.loop1_r:.0f}/{nozzle.loop2_r:.0f}/{nozzle.loop3_r:.0f} m
loop attraction ~{nozzle.interloop_force:.1e} N; loops intercept {geom.solid_angle_loops!pct:2} of the burn
requirements.gap: TBD: no magnetic nozzle has been tested with pulsed fusion plasma; inter-loop load path not designed

requirements.title: Neutral radiation escape and shielding
requirements.description: X-rays and neutrons ignore magnetic fields; only mass in their straight path stops them. Hardware dose and secondary photons are placeholders.
current: escape X-ray {shield.xray_escape!P}, neutron {shield.neutron_escape!P}; shield {shield.mass!t:3}
hardware intercepts {geom.solid_angle_total!pct:2} (x{calc.solid_angle_ratio:.1f} the study's)
requirements.target: crew <= {shield.crew_dose_budget_Sv_y:.3f} Sv/y from the drive (met on paper); hardware dose: TBD
requirements.gap: neutron production share TBD; hardware decades {shield.hardware_decades:.0f} is a placeholder; no (n,gamma), build-up or rim scatter

requirements.title: Waste-heat generation and thermal transport
requirements.description: About {calc.heat_total!P} must be collected and carried to radiators kilometres away; transport hardware is not designed.
current: hot {thermal.hot_total!P} (1800 K), warm {thermal.warm_total!P} (600 K)
plume on hardware {ledger.plume_to_hardware!P}; house + driver losses {calc.recirc_house!P}
requirements.target: loops, pumps and manifolds over {rad.wing_span:,.0f} m wings: design TBD
requirements.gap: transport booked only as {calc.transport_mass!t:2} ({calc.transport_kg_per_W:.1e} kg/W); pumping power TBD; at 1 g the heat is {calc.1g.heat!P}

requirements.title: Radiator temperature, area and mass
requirements.description: Radiated power goes as T^4. The 600 K warm loop dominates area and mass; a hotter loop is the largest single lever.
current: warm {rad.warm_area!km2} at {rad.warm_T:.0f} K, hot {rad.hot_area!km2:3} at {rad.hot_T:.0f} K
{calc.radiator_mass!t:4} of radiators; wing tips at {rad.wing_tip_radius!s} m
requirements.target: 800 K warm loop: departure -{calc.sens_800K_saving!pct:0} (needs 800 K power electronics)
requirements.gap: 1 g at the same T: {calc.1g.warm_area!km2:0} warm; material limits for 1500-2500 K TBD

requirements.title: Fuel inventory, reaction mass and storage
requirements.description: Four burns need all propellant aboard at departure; unburned fuel is the only reaction mass. Storage is a complete redesign.
current: {mass.propellant!t:5} ({calc.propellant_share!pct:0} of departure): He-3 {mass.he3!t:4}, D {mass.d!t:4}
tanks x{calc.tank_ratio_he3:.1f} He-3, x{calc.tank_ratio_d:.1f} D the existing farm; {tanks.mass!t:4}
requirements.target: proposed tank bays cover the deficit (FDP-1 T-B, +{tanks.added_length:.0f} m)
requirements.gap: He-3 supply ({mass.he3!t:2}) TBD; bay frames and bow move not designed

requirements.title: Structural stress, fatigue and maintainability
requirements.description: Every pellet is a {fusion.yield_per_pulse_tTNT:.0f} t TNT pulse; the structure sees one load cycle per pellet for years, plus km-scale wings.
current: {structure.total!t:3} structure, thrust ring at {structure.thrust_ring_ratio!pct:0} of the Q45 limit
~{calc.pulses_mission:.1e} load cycles; wing spars 25 kg/m placeholder
requirements.target: fatigue life and maintenance access over {calc.pulses_mission:.1e} cycles: TBD
requirements.gap: no fatigue, deployment or dynamics analysis; record text says 1.8e10 cycles at 100 Hz (rate is {fusion.pellet_rate:.0f} Hz)

requirements.title: Full four-burn mission and safety margins
requirements.description: Four 0.016 c burns close on {mass.propellant!t:5} without refuelling, but only on the speculative tier and with a small reserve.

reserve {mass.reserve!t:3} ({calc.reserve_share!pct:1} of propellant)
